# Welcome

This website is a collection of **calculus stories**

We explore mathematical ideas focusing on the remarkable journey of **Stokes' Theorem**.

# What this project is about

This website tells the story of Stokes’ Theorem----

> from its historical origins to its mathematical beauty—using intuitive examples, engaging illustrations, and interactive visualizations.
